Flow.description: DIR-869: Nulls Discount and DiscountAmount on every root (non-bundle-child) QuoteLineItem for a Quote once its discount approval is Rejected, per architect direction that a rejected discount must be reverted rather than left in place. Deliberately a plain record-update by filter (QuoteId + ParentQuoteLineItemId null), not a Get+loop, so it stays bulk-safe even though today's catalog only ever produces one root line per Quote. Clearing both fields here re-triggers RES_Quote_Line_Item_After_Update_Sync_Header_Discount, which cascades the clear down to Quote.AppliedDiscount/AppliedDiscountAmount/AdjustmentDistributionLogic automatically - no duplicate header-clearing logic needed here. Called as a BackgroundStep from RES_Quote_Discount_DOA_Approval_Flow's Revert_Discount_Manager_Rejection and Revert_Discount_Finance_Rejection steps, which are gated (2026-08-27 fix) to run only after Set_Rejected_Manager/Set_Rejected_Finance has actually completed - a genuine validation rule on QuoteLineItem blocks any Discount/DiscountAmount change while Quote.Status = 'Pending Approval', and without that ordering dependency this step raced Set_Rejected_* and consistently failed with FIELD_CUSTOM_VALIDATION_EXCEPTION since Status hadn't committed to Rejected yet. The fault path here still catches any other failure so it can never take down the actual approval routing. Note: nulling these fields via Flow DML does not itself force NetUnitPrice to recompute (Revenue Cloud's repricing engine is not triggered by a plain field update) - the line item's Discount/DiscountAmount will correctly show blank, but NetUnitPrice may show its last-calculated value until the record is next repriced (Reprice All, or reopening with Instant Pricing on). 2026-08-28: added Set_Pricing_Stale_Flag as the first step - sets Quote.RES_Pricing_Stale__c = true so the pricing-stale warning banner (productSoftHoldBanner instance on the Quote page) shows until the quote is either repriced (cleared by RES_Quote_Before_Save_Clear_Pricing_Stale_Flag) or a new discount is entered (cleared by RES_Quote_Line_Item_After_Update_Sync_Header_Discount).
